stocks.name: Tri-X 400
stocks.title: TRI-X
stocks.official_note: 400TX, not 320TXP. D-76 stock 20 C small tank 6.75 min; publication F-4017. Community emulsion generation and developer are undocumented.
stocks.reference: same-stock G MIC community LUT; adaptation assumes display sRGB

stocks.name: Ilford Delta 100
stocks.title: DELTA
stocks.official_note: Delta 100 Professional, ISO 100, fine-grain core-shell stock; D-76 stock 20 C 9 min at EI 100 (ID-11 stock is 8.5 min). Apr 2023 technical sheet.
stocks.reference: same-stock G MIC community LUT; adaptation assumes display sRGB

stocks.name: Ilford Pan 400
stocks.title: PAN
stocks.official_note: ILFORD manufacturer fact sheet, March 2002, archived by 125px. PAN 400, not Kentmere, HP5 or Pan F. D-76 stock 20 C 7 min at EI 400; 1+1 13 min. No spectral/density curve supplied.
stocks.reference: independent official-informed tonal interpretation; no verified same-stock community LUT or physical calibration

stocks.name: Rollei Infrared 400
stocks.title: INFRARED
stocks.official_note: R210701: hyperpanchromatic, nominal ISO 200-400; extended response 650-750 nm; recommended filters 715-730 nm. D-76/ID-11 stock 20 C 10:50, gamma 0.65 guideline.
stocks.reference: same-stock G MIC community LUT; adaptation assumes display sRGB
stocks.description: Infrared filter style approximation; visible RGB only

stocks.name: Ilford SFX 200
stocks.title: SFX
stocks.official_note: Nov 2018 SFX 200 extended-red stock. Deep-red filtered target: dark blue sky and bright green foliage. D-76 stock 20 C 10 min, 1+1 14.5 min at EI 200.
stocks.reference: independent official-informed tonal interpretation; no verified same-stock community LUT or physical calibration

stocks.name: Fomapan 400
stocks.title: FOMAPAN
stocks.official_note: Fomapan 400 Action, nominal ISO 400. Official 04/23 sheet: D-76/ID-11 stock 20 C 7-8 min. Published characteristic curve and RMS 17.5 concern Microphen, not a D-76 measurement.

stocks.name: CatLABS X Film 80
stocks.title: X FILM
stocks.official_note: User-delegated choice: MKII formulation; exact display name unchanged. Maker describes fine grain, moderate contrast and broad tones; D-76/ID-11 stock 20 C 8 min at EI 80, 1+1 11 min. No full density/spectral curve published.
